semiconductor_relevance: High — PentaPro Materials Inc. specializes in semiconductor-grade ultra-high purity precursors and specialty gases critical for semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: PentaPro Materials Inc. is a leading supplier of ultra-high purity precursors and specialty gases for the semiconductor industry, focusing on high-quality materials with purity levels up to 8N. The company also offers cylinder cleaning and refilling services, along with custom chemical development to meet specific customer needs.
capabilities: Production of semiconductor-grade ultra-high purity precursors
Custom chemical development for specialty gases
Trace analysis and purification of precursors

regional_presence.Taiwan: PentaPro Materials Inc. has production facilities located in Tainan Science Industrial Park.
